lines.text: Daniel mourns for three full weeks, then on the twenty-fourth day of the first month he stands by the Tigris.
Daniel sees a man dressed in linen with a belt of gold from Ophir, and the men with him run and hide.
Daniel loses his strength and falls into a deep sleep, then a hand touches him and he is told to stand up.
The prince of Persia opposed the speaker for twenty-one days, then Gabriel came to help him.
Daniel becomes speechless, one with the likeness of a man touches his lips and strengthens him, and says he must fight the prince of Persia.
